Bucharest Traffic Nightmare Unchanged: 10 Kilometers in Over 45 Minutes at Rush Hour

2026-09-07 Euronews Romania TomTom Traffic Index, Bucharest, traffic congestion, Romania, GPS data, urban mobility, rush hour, commuting
Read the source article

Quick summary

Bucharest ranks 20th globally in the TomTom Traffic Index 2025, with drivers losing nearly 171 hours per year in traffic — a 10km trip taking over 45 minutes at evening rush hour, and conditions worsening compared to 2024.

Key takeaways

  • Bucharest ranks 20th worldwide in the TomTom Traffic Index 2025 for most congested cities
  • A 10-kilometer trip takes over 32 minutes on average, exceeding 45 minutes during evening rush hour
  • Average speed during congested periods drops to approximately 14 km/h
  • Drivers lose nearly 171 hours per year in traffic, equivalent to over 7 days
  • October 7, 2025 was the most congested day, with congestion reaching 106% and 176% at 5 PM
  • Travel times for 10km trips increased by 1 minute 11 seconds compared to 2024, while average rush hour speed decreased by 1 km/h
